ns2:section.sectionText: As of Fall 2021, the B.S. Statistics major will no longer include STAT 420. Stat Majors are encouraged to take STAT 425: Statistical Modeling I instead, and then its complement STAT 426: Statistical Modeling II in a later term. STAT 420 will continue to be offered for the Statistics minor and other programs. Please consult Statistics Advising with any questions. For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
